meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (state estimates from each state's Directorate of Economics and Statistics)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year is the state's latest estimate; states revise at different times and the API carries no revision label. The newest year is usually an advance or quick estimate.
meta.coverage: Per-capita net state domestic product (income per person) by state, ₹ at constant 2011-12 prices
meta.note: MoSPI NAS regional account, indicator 25 (30 states); indicator 32 for the states 25 does not serve (Assam, Haryana, Ladakh, Nagaland). 32 equals 25 wherever both are served and 32 is not a copied block. Excluded as a server defect: Karnataka, whose indicator 32 rows repeat indicator 31, per-capita GSDP (current equals constant in every year). Per-capita figures use each state's own population estimate, as published; we never divide by a population of our own. J&K split at 2019-20.
